limitations: Judged from logs and tests; nothing was run. Counts are quoted from the logs, not reproduced. All 21 logs share head 4c6ac696e and I confirmed with git diff that no source, test or script file changed between 4c6ac696e and HEAD d65141274. The statement that the PG-202 integration RLS session test ran rather than skipped is still inferred from the 20 passed + 5 skipped count. I did not diff-check the full set of tests edited in existing files for weakened assertions. Mutation testing is not configured. The verdict reads the web threshold as apps/web/CLAUDE.md states it (branches >= 80); under the Quality agent's flat 90% rule the web branch figures of 81-88% on new files and the CheckConflicts legacy branches (70%) would not pass, so the PASS depends on that documented per-package threshold and on judging legacy-file gaps by the diff.
